author: WraithLike
quote: Spoilers ahead. The Writing was on the wall with Abigail and Sadie in RDR2. They were completely immune to any and all criticism in the story and now this game has gone and done that ten thousand fold with Lucia.I don’t want to spoil anything else without warning so stop reading here now-Lucia is completely immune to the aforementioned criticism in the story and she is simply a complete **** catalyst for the games story even starting is her Wreckless impulsive decisions, first she asks Jason to take her out robbing stores and when He says “no,it’s dangerous” she proceeds to break up with him and commit an armed robbery while she has her Baby and get caught and subsequently loses custody of the baby.2 key points about this-1. When Jason finds out what happened he does not I repeat does not utter one word of disapproval or disappointment in her about committing armed robbery while she is supposed to be taking care of a baby.2. The only time she is questioned about this her explanation is simply “It was stupid” and then it’s brushed under the rug, no further scrutiny for our beloved mary sue.I will say the gameplay after you pass the slog that is the first 30 percent of the game is fun but the story, driving and shooting are all either dogwater or just downgrades from previous entries in the **** not buy this game if you want a good story that feels good and balanced between two characters, it’s clear that Jason was probably shoehorned in the last year or two of production because he literally has less personality than the GTA online character from GTA5 and only serves as a doormat for the true main character. I will let you go now, thanks for reading my **** have a superb attention span.
